feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 September 2026 11:58am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 22 September 2026 at 11:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the south of England will decline, frontal system will move quickly through the Irish Sea tomorrow morning.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 2 to 4, veering and increasing North or Northwest 5 or 6 later tonight or at first tomorrow morning, possibly touching 7 for a time in east of area, then decreasing 4 or 5 later in morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building moderate later.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches today. Becoming fair for a time early tonight, then rain for a time later in night and at first tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches. Becoming generally moderate or good tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 later tomorrow, then Variable 2 or 3 overnight into Thursday. Settling and gradually increasing South 4 to 6 on Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, falling smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate on Thursday morning.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
